title: Huntington National Bank Has $137.90 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Matthew Jenks on Jan 22nd, 2019 // No Comments
Huntington National Bank reduced its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.3% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 610,882 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 21,090 shares during the period. Apple accounts for 2.2% of Huntington National Bank’s portfolio, making the stock its 4th largest position. Huntington National Bank’s holdings in Apple were worth $137,900,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
A number of other hedge funds also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the stock. Farmers Trust Co. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.2% during the second quarter. Farmers Trust Co. now owns 51,527 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,538,000 after purchasing an additional 587 shares during the period. New Capital Management LP boosted its stake in Apple by 28.4% during the second quarter. New Capital Management LP now owns 22,135 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,097,000 after buying an additional 4,901 shares in the last quarter. Fisher Asset Management LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 4.0% during the second quarter. Fisher Asset Management LLC now owns 12,159,643 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,250,872,000 after buying an additional 466,888 shares in the last quarter. ELM Advisors LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 5.1% during the second quarter. ELM Advisors LLC now owns 12,812 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,372,000 after buying an additional 620 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Nadler Financial Group Inc. boosted its stake in Apple by 2.7% during the second quarter. Nadler Financial Group Inc. now owns 53,989 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,994,000 after buying an additional 1,398 shares in the last quarter. 57.05% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. Several research analysts recently weighed in on the company. Oppenheimer reaffirmed a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 1st. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Monday, October 1st. Macquarie reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $235.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, September 27th. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and set a $215.00 target price (up previously from $210.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, September 28th. Finally, Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $195.74.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $156.82 on Tuesday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $142.00 and a 1-year high of $233.47. The firm has a market capitalization of $770.79 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.17, a P/E/G ratio of 1.49 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter last year, the company posted $2.07 EPS. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 EPS for the current fiscal year.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600.
